text.en:
The bed capacity of the Puerto Princesa Hospital in the City of Puerto Princesa is hereby
increased to one hundred twenty-five beds.

Such amount as may be determined by the Minister of the Budget necessary for the
implementation of this Act shall be charged to the appropriations of the Ministry of Health authorized under
Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for hospitals. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
